author: Nicknames_are_a_daft_req
title: Not really a game
content:
This app is disguised as a game, but it’s really an app designed to deliver a selection of ads over and over and over again. I’m at Level 629 at the moment and the ads now take up almost as much time as the game. Worse, many of the ads require to tap through 4 or more screens, some of which are design to take you to the App Store on the first tap, regardless where you tap. The close X in most ads is minute and so easy to miss. You quickly learn the sequences to get rid of the ads as they repeat and repeat and repeat. 

Yes I can pay the people to stop the ads, but I don’t believe that will do it. There will be more layers of different ads, because the game is incidental to the purpose of the app, which is to make money from ad views.

If you love ads, this is the app for you. But if you want to actually play a game, try something else, if you can find a genuinely ad-free application that includes a game.

No it’s not my phone or wifi that caused the drag. A

author: Boobie0
title: this game sucks
content: Game does not work properly cannot enjoy my other game. Please stop sending this game.

author: ambiguity2
title: Ad is broken
content: Playing another game, the ad for this game isn’t acting right. It keeps putting up the store page over and over and doesn’t close properly.

author: Sir Stuck'n Blocks
title: Sample game keeps crashing
content: When I watch the video for the sample game , it crashes and never lets me get back to my game. I end up restarting the game I've been playing just to get out of this loop. After closing the pop-up box several times I even managed to get through the sample game and it still doesn't let me get back to my game. Can you fix this please?

author: Willow757575
title: Pop up horror show
content: Trying to play a different game and every time I get an ad for this one it keeps auto opening my app store and repeatedly popping up the store page and not letting me exit the ad. Way to scream “scam game”.

author: RedhotQD
title: Enjoyable, but it cost a lot to get past the hard levels
content: This game has frozen pieces I needed to move, multiple times just when I’m about to win a very hard level and usually after I’ve paid extra for extra time or an extra tool to blast an extra block. it’s a scam. There’s other games that are better options. I’ve wasted way too much money on this game.

author: Kmichelle1908
title: CRASHING
content: App is literally crashing 10+ times per day

author: ShakyJD
title: Stuffed with ads now
content: Was a ton of fun until latest update. Now there’s an ad after every other level that often makes you fully close the app to get passed

author: secrate Pirate
title: Ads stick
content: When this pops up as an ad, it will block your feed! Fix it!!

author: Reel Numan
title: Great game
content: Honestly seeing the other reviews yeah you can spend money on power ups and stuff but i just earn them free and im at level 501 currently so im having a great time on this game

author: 5 out of. 5
title: Fun and cool
content: It is very fun if you are mad I would recommend this game

author: checald
title: Daily Prize
content: This is my favorite game! As you get up on levels, they get harder to beat. Since it’s so difficult & I play every single day, it would be nice if we got some type of daily rewards for logging in. Rather it be coins, boosts, etc. I would love if we can get something everyday you log in instead of having to beat a level to get a reward

author: Fur-balloons
title: Slow responsiveness
content: The tiles do not move based on the instructions from the user. The clock continues to lose time, even though the game does not respond to the users instructions. This is a really poorly designed game.

author: wooooover
title: Ad takeover
content: Playing another game is bad enough when I’m forced to watch ads. But instead of being able to close out the ads it opens Color Block Jam. Hate it

author: suuprmansd
title: The ad for this game said no timers. Lied
content: There were no ads for like the first 10 levels or something. They started and are totally ridiculous. The power ups add like 5 seconds. There are way better games off the same type out there. This one: DELETED

author: ASLTERP94
title: This game is so bad!
content: So annoying. It keeps sending me adds after I downloaded it!

author: Cow26!
title: Ads
content: I love the game but the dang ads drive me insane!

author: traceeesteveee
title: Too easy
content: Levels are way too easy I want you to give out a game that is way harder super hard

author: stephjjjsj
title: LAGGY
content: I had no problems with this app until recently, it crashes then kicks you out of the game. It’s getting so annoying now, I want to delete the app.

author: Grixxit
title: AI response team
content:
Placed a ticket informing the team of an issue where the game becomes unresponsive on levels containing time bombs when the timer drops below five, meaning you get significantly less time than displayed.

Their response just stated that each level was designed to be completed within the time allowed. 

I guess the game freezing up is intentional and you’re supposed to watch helplessly as the bomb timer reaches zero.

author: santana1fan
title: Good Game, Fake Rewards
content: This is fun if you enjoy puzzles but after playing over 700 games, my experience with customer service and their ‘rewards’ is that it’s a scam. They show you that you’ve won something useful, but don’t actually provide the reward. I’ve reported this repeatedly and the response is that I don’t know how to read the screen. 🙄

author: Sebetha’s Choice
title: Color Block Jam
content: Color Block Jam is great fun and a creative brain game for all ages. I play while waiting for my kids in the car. My children love the bright colors, simple yet challenging that which keeps my children sharper with each level. Even my grandmother is 78 years old enjoys it. It can also be a fun family game that players can rotate turns to play as well. Very happy to find this game.

author: Jackkrae
title: Extra lives
content: I don’t get the point in having us pay to be able to accrue 8 “lives” just for it to stop accruing at 7. I shouldn’t open the app after many hours and only have 7 “lives” when we all know that if you’re stuck on a level you go through them quickly. I should already have 8 so that when I lose one it’s already working on the next one not the one that should already be there. Don’t charge me to get 8 lives if you’re not going to give me 8 lives.

author: Ed 's Review
title: Don’t care for the new icon.
content:
The old icon made me want to play the game it was fun and inviting. Even my kids wanted to play it. It makes more sense to the title and game play but it makes it less inviting or a desire to play it.
There was something with the mustache and the eyes that drew me in to wanting to play the game rather than having no connection and just a logic game. 
If there’s a way for preference in setting, I would definitely set it back to the older one. Five stars with the old icon. Three stars with a generic icon.
Logic is good and tricky.

author: Dmdndnd cm
title: Glitch
content: Every time I open the app it randomly closes eventually after ten or so minutes. It is incredibly annoying because I lose all progress on the level I am on and whatever power ups I used are completely gone. It is a problem with this app specific ally because it doesn’t not happen with any other app on my device. I love love love this game otherwise but this glitch makes me not want to play it.

author: BeautifulBitch
title: Game Is Fun but starting to get very upset to delete
content: I have been playing this game for a little while now and I like the “Color Block Jam” game best but it stopped giving me my rewards after level 20 it says next one is at level 30 and I am now almost at level 60 and still no reward points for level 30 or 50 so I submitted a ticket with screen shots and still nothing…. I really wish the developers would get this fixed and give my reward points to me and so answer the tickets. So that is why I am leaving a 2 star review because I do like the games

author: jessinoel7
title: Timer
content: This is a super fun game. I love playing it. It would be a 11/10 game if there was an option to play without a timer. Sometimes I just want to play when I’m waiting for something or when I just want a fun puzzle game. But the timer ruins it, especially because there are no “relaxing” levels. Every single one is designed for you to race the timer. It ruins it about 80% of the time. I would likely even consider making some in-app purchases if playing without a timer was an option.

author: RobinSixOh
title: Challenging but glitchy…
content: I became intrigued with this game through the playable ads on another game app. I love logic puzzles and this game satisfies that. I rated it 3 stars for the following problems: the timing is too short on Hard levels; the time extension and additional lives links just don’t work; the coin rewards are too low — one would have to play for hours and days to earn 900 coins for a life refill and I have home & work lives to maintain. I also suggest a Daily Check In reward scheme of some kind. Thanks for listening!

author: Mamadragon742
title: Why no daily rewards?
content: A really fun and challenging game - but why don’t they offer daily rewards? I don’t mind getting stuck on a level, even for several days. But a daily rewards helps get you past the really tough levels that have very strict time limits. I have been stuck for several days now and am not interested in paying money - they get money from the ads… so not offering a little bonus to the players feels cheap

author: Strange_Sleepy_Duck
title: It’s good but..
content: Adds. It’s a good game. Good gameplay and premise but it has adds. Which wouldn’t be a problem if you could turn off wifi and play but it requires wifi. It shouldn’t, it’s  not an online game nor is it a big game that would require a more than mobile data. And $8 for adds is ridiculous and unnecessary. WAY too much for a small game. An add after EVERY level after a certain point make it extremely annoying to play and just make one want to uninstall the app.

author: LadySvedka
title: Disable the timer!
content: I love this game. I am on level 1714 so when I say I play a lot, I mean it. However, as you get this far into the game the puzzles are impossible without using a rocket or hammer. Not because the puzzles are more complicated, but because you have to complete one in sometimes less than a minute. It’s insane. I find it more anxiety inducing than enjoyable at this point and will likely have to find another game :(

author: Pylecheer00
title: Should be AWESOME
content: I love this game. It’s addictive and challenging enough with being impossible. Except after a while, it gets impossible without spending money in power ups or extra “lives”. You get to a point where it feels impossible to win in the allotted time and it feels like another game just trying to get you addicted and then take your money. I would watch ads for things as I know they need to make money so it would be nice if that were an option. But at this point I have erased the app as I can’t move on without spending money on power up.

author: Bushbush124
title: Another game ruined by greedy developers
content: Not worth it. Could be very fun & addicting but the designers are too greedy & want ppl to watch ads. The timer is way too short and they only give like 4 to 5 lives (which is a super lame & outdated way of designing a game). They want to make ppl watch endless ads for everything- an ad to to add more time, an ad to add a life, etc. When you run out of time (which you definitely will) they want you to spend 900 points for 20 SECONDS of extra time. Greedy designing and not worth it. I already found another better game (with sound) and will probably delete this one. Don’t waste your time.

author: Out of Ballpark
title: Too pushy to sell features
content: Way too many hard levels that are next to impossible to solve. I want to simply have fun, not spend days trying to unlock a stupid puzzle that doesn’t seem to want to reward you in anyway. Often all you get is a meager extra 3 seconds. I think they do that Just to push you to buy things. Most of the places will allow you to watch a video or otherwise allow you to be able to keep on playing. But this one seems to like to stump you for days. Do I have time to spend with one hard impossible level after another for days? No thanks.

author: Sharla Kay
title: Frustrating game
content: This could be a very engaging and enjoyable game, but games are TIMED…and they do not give enough time to work it out.  It starts out easy, but quickly escalates to impossible (without using your points to buy a few more seconds…and even then hard to finish).  I feel very rushed.  I have apps for several very challenging games that I enjoy because they challenge me to figure it out…and I do watch ads…and sometimes even download what they are advertising.  Isn’t that how they earn money?  All I’m doing with this one is deleting it.

author: skelekatie
title: Make it easier to delete progress
content:
I was addicted to this game until I got to the 500 levels and it was just not fun anymore. If you get stuck on a puzzle and don’t have any power ups (yes, there are levels that are impossible without power ups) there is no way to earn coins or get a hint. You’re forced to buy your way out (with real money).
To get your progress whipped to start over and have fun again, you have to send them a request. I’ve done it once successfully but can’t get them to do it a second time. Even after getting a confirmation email my progress was still not deleted.

author: zoolights787$!
title: Only wants your money!!!
content:
This game has a great premise, entertaining and fun to start.  Quite a bit of adds, but enough tokens to begin with. Then bam it’s like you’re only getting a chance to play if you pay! I am SO sick of these stupid games! Such a waste! Not even giving a chance to replay lower levels to make more tokens in your own. The help is a waste of time also just very clear the makers only want you to get to a level you’re so annoyed with you for ok $100! An HUNDRED DOLLARS!!!???!! To play a game! And it’s not even to play forever that’s only a certain amount of tokens that you WILL RUNNOUT OFF! 
Clearly the makers are Greedy Greedy Greedy!!! No NO Nooooooo!

author: Richardp1973
title: Could be better
content:
The game itself is fun and frustrating. 
I would like to see bonus rounds where we can win axes or freeze times in order to beat rounds.  
It gets old playing the same round 100 times before finally beating the level.  
And we shouldn’t have to beat 30 levels before getting 1 bonus. 
The canyon chase is out of the question.  Not many people can beat 7 straight levels to get a bonus.

author: bearyfrosty
title: Fun game not worth if playing via Optimity
content:
Ads aren’t really intrusive until around lvl 40 onwards. Gameplay is simple yet engaging, especially as more mechanics are introduced in later levels. 

My only gripe is that the integration it has with Optimity is pretty crummy. You’ll get rewarded for completing the first 10 levels (975 gems), and that’s it. I reached lvl 88 (which should’ve given me an additional 6988 gems). After about two weeks of initially installing, I still haven’t gotten my rewards.
Reached out to Optimity support, they claimed it’s the game itself that’s not reporting my level progress.

author: Marigold2008
title: Fun but there are forced purchases
content: This is a fun game, but at level 24 I couldn’t find any solution without using the hammer or vacuum  and I was out of them. There’s no option to get a hint, and no option to watch a commercial to get what you need. Basically, you’re forced to make a purchase or not continue. In game purchases are one thing, being forced to do so or quit playing is another. Hence my 3 star rating. Also, I couldn’t play offline despite the fact that there are no or few ads.

author: Toomanychanges
title: Would love it
content: I made it to level 88 before I’d had enough, here’s why. 1. The ads are typical for just about any free game! The people complaining about the amount of ads must not have played “free” games before. I love the concept of the game. I do not like the timer. Could play for hours if it didn’t have it. I hit back to back “very hard” levels that could not be beat without using power ups. This ended the game for me. I will not be forced to buy power ups. Developers make money from all the ads I sat through. Buying power ups should be a choice.  I’ll actually miss the game, but not enough to spend more money.

author: ophelia174
title: Time too short
content:
This would be a great puzzle game if it weren’t for the super short amount of time you get for each level. On some of the harder levels I can do it over and over, memorize the exact steps to complete everything, race to do
It as fast as I can and still not finish before the timer goes off. It’s so frustrating as soon as you solve the puzzle and figure out how to beat it the time runs out and you have to start over. It’s so frustrating I’m going to look for another puzzle game that doesn’t make you speed solve it.

author: ginnygirl81
title: Game goes to a dead end
content:
I’m on level 329, I’ve studied the board many times and tried it 10 times. Thee is NO way to even get one block out without having to use special help. So, this is where they MAKE you buy and spend your money in order to continue. 
Needing 900 coins to buy ONE special help. Only getting 40 coins after each level completion without watching a video, Or just 80 coins if you do(which the videos are the longest I’ve ever had to wait for in a game.) 
It would take 11.5 games at 80 coins to only have enough for one special.

author: Yelra93
title: Needs Updating
content: I have two games from Rollic, both require you to buy coins in order to use power ups if you’ve run out of the coins you’ve earned. They should give an option to watch ads to earn a power up because we’re watching ads after every round anyways. Also, if you choose your coin reward without ad at the end of your round, you’re still getting an ad after clicking it so you might as well click the double coins with ad button.

author: TIME211
title: I keep getting double the ads to play one round.
content: For every two rounds I play the games brings up another ad even when I still have free purchased turns to play. So if I have zero purchased rounds I must watch two ads to get another round. I keep having to watch double the ads even though I have already earned new rounds to play.

author: TrashScreamer
title: Good But By God The Time Limits & Limited Lives
content: Personally i v much like the gameplay loop but i cannot stand how tight some of these time limits are and the v small amount of lives available. its either pay money for fake lives in my digital game or not play. like i feel the limited lives thing goes against getting ppl to play your game, aint many people gonna be dropping more than the no ads purchase on this sorta game. theyre more likely to simply delete it and find another game that isnt trying to cash grab so hard

author: Mainah 207
title: No app support
content: There is absolutely no way to reset progress. If you want to reset you’re told to request it, and you’ll receive and email letting you know when it’s done.  It’s been two weeks and I haven’t been reset. I tried uninstalling and a factory reset too.  All no success.  Not often do I want to reset progress, but when I do want to reset it should be an option.  I tried to contact the help chat as well, and have received no replies. It’s been a week.  No support, and you’re stuck.  Beyond frustrated because I really do like the game.

author: Centavo78
title: Really fun game, rip-off in app purchases
content:
The game is well designed and fun to play. It progresses in difficulty and challenges your mind. That part is awesome. I finally paid for the "ad free" version ($8ish), but after you use a handful of "lives" there are STILL ADS!!! That was frustrating enough, but progress several more levels (around 95 to be exact), and they quit giving you s as reasonable amount of time to finish the puzzle. And the only way to pass is to BUY COINS FOR 20 extra seconds. Good grief! I miss being able to pay a decent price for an app and just have access to play the game. 
It feels deceitful!!

author: h8appl3
title: 20 coins per level?
content: The winnings are pathetic. You can’t build up enough to buy lives when you get in to the higher levels. I enjoy the timer and the game in general but no daily gifts, no accumulation of time or money. You would get more people play if there was more opportunities to continue. I use my 5 lives and I’m done for the day. I’m not sitting around waiting for 2.5 hours. Even if I am on a roll I still can only make about 400 coins at a time. It takes days to earn. I like the game but the wait in between makes it not so worth it.

author: Angelo15344
title: Ads
content: I love this game to its core it’s an amazing game that has a lot of potential to be an amazing pass time. My only concern is that there is an add every time you finish a level and I find myself not wanting to play anymore after a certain amount of adds. I definitely understand having adds but after every level it is extremely annoying and makes that game almost unplayable at times!

author: Jmfroggie
title: Love this but
content:
I really love the challenge, but the bugs or quirks of the game are on the edge of enough to delete it entirely. 

I’ve had TWO first to go pieces at the same time and it’s destroyed my 10 wins plus consecutive wins, or it crashing and lost all my progress!  Some of the help changes gates and some don’t so I’ve wasted help because it didn’t actually change a gate. 
This is the third time I’ve lost all my progress, all my continuance coins in one week! 

The game also makes you play 4 games into new block types or gate styles before it will even tell you what it is or does! So then you lose lives trying to figure it out. 

The WORST is the timer keeps ticking while you’re making your help selection so by the time you’ve used a help, you’re now 2800 coins spent with no more ability to progress!

author: Aurora McK
title: WARNING
content: While it’s a great puzzle game and I don’t mind the challenging levels, it will BURN your phone and kill your battery. My phone is constantly overheating after 10-15 minutes of gameplay. I can watch full videos or play other games for over an hour before it reaches the same temperature as this game in 10-15 minutes. I would not expect this much battery drain or phone usage for a game unless there is something dubious going on in the background for it to constantly require internet access to even load the game. Be warned!

author: Dahbih
title: Ridiculous timeframe to complete levels
content: Some levels are so complicated and they give you  just over a minute to work it out. You have to wait HOURS for more “lives” to continue playing extremely challenging levels that sometimes even when you know the solution, you barely have enough time to physically shift the pieces. All in an attempt to make you pay 900 coins (almost $2 of real money worth) for an additional 20 seconds of time on a. Level. Just a ludicrous ratio. Could be a fun game if it weren’t such a painfully disgusting money grab and near impossible levels based on the time limit.

author: DontGetBuggered
title: Great idea, needs some settings/options
content:
It is a fun concept. It was relaxing until the game started using more complicated puzzles with the timing of every level. I get that some people like a hard challenge, but I want a relaxing challenge. 

This game might be more popular if there was a setting that allowed the player to choose between aggressive timer, a moderate timer, and NO timer. I will probably delete this game after playing it one or two more times. I don’t need the stress. I want to relax.

author: c._.lyons
title: Fun but too many ads
content: I like the game but I deleted it because of all the ads. I get you have to fund this thing somehow and if you’re not charging me, that means watching ads. I’m okay with that generally, but these levels are far too short for there to be an ad after very nearly every single one. The ads are also quite short, but to me, having to watch 15 seconds of ads after each level when most of the levels only take me like 45 seconds to a minute to complete just isn’t worth it.

author: Eurodancer
title: Thinking with Legos!
content: Finally a puzzle game that actually makes you think and doesn’t require watching ads to solve! There are only ads after completing a game and as a small banner which I don’t mind. The timer and different obstacles make a nicely challenging. And if you’re a LEGO fan like me, the fact that the blocks have studs just makes it even better. :)

author: EIon Musķ
title: Canyon Chase Issue
content: The Canyon Chase mode should not have its prize split among competitors. This challenge is already incredibly difficult, requiring players to complete seven levels beyond level 100 in succession. While the $10,000 grand prize may seem generous at first, the reality is that individual players often receive only $1,000 or less after the split. To maintain the challenge’s appeal and ensure the reward feels worthwhile, players who successfully complete it should receive at least $5,000 a balanced amount that keeps the prize valuable without being overpowered

author: phillycaro
title: Very fun, please add untimed option
content: This game is very fun! The pieces move freely and it’s a great brain teaser to figure out how to get them out of the box. I wish there was an untimed option because sometimes I just want to do it for fun without stressing about the time. I also wish I could go back to previous levels to play them again. It’s an otherwise nearly perfect game!

author: GenY.
title: I really like this game but….
content:
I really enjoy playing this game but I think there are a few things that need to be adjusted.

1. The timer needs to be extended a bit. It doesn’t feel good to have to constantly rush and try to win a level that is already challenging
2. Forty coins per round?!? Even for the hard levels…come onnn. More more more lol that’s too low!
3. You should have more opportunities to receive power ups. They are too far and in between.
4. Have a mode where you can play without a time limit.
5. It’s too easy to blow through lives...there should be an option to watch an add to extend the time on the current level instead of having to start over again if you don’t have enough coins

I don’t mind the challenge but I think some adjustments can be made to make it more fun, less stressful and not feel that it’s about money!

Thank you!!

author: Forever in Memory
title: 3 Lives?
content:
This is a one of the greatest challenging games. My only complaint is there only three  lives/games. You must pay to play, watch another ad, or wait to play again? When I have time to play and almost figured out the blocks, I have to wait. 
I find the games that have endless lives or continuous play, are played more often and the play sessions are longer. Those games do not get deleted.

author: UserNameRequired
title: Not much fun unless you pay
content: I downloaded this because of ads for it on another game. Still haven’t played a level similar to the ads. Levels are much harder and also have very short timers to finish. I don’t mind a challenge, but timer is so short it’s almost no fun. I’m only on level 25 and already have been through a few levels that were very hard without using power ups or adding time. No ads for time either. Just a game built to pay to play and play isn’t cheap. I’m deleting

author: Caerph1lly
title: Used to love this
content: The bombs and insane times make this stressful and frustrating and unplayable. I’ve played this for a bit, I’m on level 337, and I can’t do it anymore. I want a challenging puzzle, not a frustrating one where I can’t figure it out because I only have 20 seconds at a time because a stupid bomb goes off. Devs obviously want you to pay for boosters. I’d rather just pay for an actual challenging game. I used to love playing this, but every level is just getting frustrating. My job and life is frustrating enough.

author: Rebakrejci
title: THIS IS NOT A RELAXING GAME
content: The makers of this game had only 1 thing in mind when they designed it… GREED. They make the time limits too short to finish a game without rehearsing the moves while using up all of your lives or paying for the privilege of adding a measly 20 seconds to a level. What should be a fun puzzle to solve turns into high blood pressure followed by anger. Despite all of the requests on the internet to make a version of the game without time limits, it will never happen because the game designers aren’t trying to make a game you like, they’re trying to make a game that puts your money in their pocket.

author: DrumPhil65
title: Good, but too harsh
content: This is a fun and challenging puzzle game, but the problem is that it is too unforgiving. Some levels (even “easy” ones) can take many, many tries to accomplish, and the game gives no hints at what is being missed. It would be a big improvement to allow a non-timed mode. Or after using up all lives, allow players to continue to complete a level without the clock to get past a frustrating level without scoring any reward.

author: Grrr-ads
title: Fun puzzles, but it needs a zen mode
content: The puzzles are entertaining.  But the timers and the bombs in particular make them a lot less fun. Sometimes there isn’t even enough time to move the blocks fast enough to beat them even if you’ve figured out the exact choreography in advance.  I know they are trying to force you to buy the power-ups, but I would rather just pay for the game and have the option to turn them off so I can just enjoy the puzzle.

author: bootydousedinlean
title: Game is fire but not for the mentally challenged
content: I love this game but I need more time as I am slow! As soon as I’m about to complete a level the time runs out which make it less enjoyable. If you like to take your time with games this one with make you frustrated. I’m the slow and steady wins the race kind of person so I was disappointed when I saw that you only get 1 minute and thirty seconds to complete the level even for hard levels. Wish they had like an easy, hard, and medium modes in the settings  :(

author: Twitch-55
title: Unrealistic puzzles
content: At the higher levels it’s too many hard levels too close to each other that force you to spend coins or power ups to win to eventually cause you to run out of them and the only way to win is by spending money. I’ve been stuck on one level for a month now and deleting because there’s nothing I can do to beat it. Was fun until I got to higher levels, now just frustrating. At least give us an option to watch an add for a free power up of some kind.

author: Criout
title: Fun at first…
content:
This game has a lot of potential but unfortunately, after your clear the first 100 or so levels, they are all difficult. Even the ones that are not labeled as difficult take multiple tries to clear the level. Don’t bother trying to solve the multiple levels in a row to race your peers… you simply will not be able to without spending either all your coins or buying more (which I suppose is the strategy here…)

Again, starts out fun but really doesn’t last as you go deeper into the game

author: lelecalhoun
title: Way to Challenging
content: I like to be challenged and I even get an adrenaline rush when racing against the clock, but there are way too many extra hard puzzles to solve within the time limit provided. I deleted the app, found a few other games that were similar, and for some reason came back to this one just to see if it was just me. Well, it still may be just me, but I decided, this one is no longer fun, and I’ll have to delete it again.

author: rabid lamb
title: Great Game, Insanely Expensive
